blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – A low-pressure area (LPA) that developed into a tropical depression may enter the Philippine Area of Responsibility (PAR) in the coming days, the weather bureau said on Tuesday. In its 5 a.m. bulletin, PAGASA said the tropical cyclone was located 2,675 km. east of Eastern Visayas, moving north-northeastward at 15 kph with maximum sustained winds of 55 kph near the center and gustiness of up to 70 kph.
